first.rationale: Onboarding completion is down 4% quarter over quarter, and prior evidence indicates that shortening onboarding and reducing signup friction improve activation and time-to-value. I would verify the two most directly relevant records before running a narrowly scoped test, while guarding against optimizing completion without improving qualified revenue.

final.rationale: Run a standard randomized onboarding simplification experiment this week, prioritizing shorter flows and fewer required signup fields for self-serve SMB accounts. The verified onboarding result improved completion, time-to-value, and 30-day retention, while signup simplification improved SMB activation and qualified revenue despite a small retention decline. Measure activation, time-to-value, qualified revenue, and 30-day retention—not completion alone—and preserve segment-level analysis because the signup result was only replicated in SMB.
